## 8a008c62d9e9

**Reproduced teaching shortcut — one span per row survives the default
curriculum.** The canonical rule independently fills the span between repeated
endpoints of each color. The default generator emits only one repeated color per
active row, so the rival "fill one span from the row's leftmost nonzero cell to
its rightmost nonzero cell using the leftmost color" matched 200/200 draws in
each of easy, medium, and hard (`seed=27000+i`, `sample_index=i`, `i=0..199`).

A checker-admitted 5x9 input with two repeated colors in one row separates the
rules: the Racket output creates separate color-2 and color-4 spans, while the
rival merges the whole row as color 2. Exact hashes, input, outputs, schedule,
and command are in `checks/audit/8a008c62d9e9/counterexample.json`; supported
Racket evidence is `checks/audit/8a008c62d9e9/racket.json`. Generator SHA-256 is
`17303b2c8e3e8e75af11baee20502fa2fca5e603157726fdaa246ec0dffb1c75`
and rule hash is `f10c87bddaf0`.

A secondary override-stage replay also failed: it reported 8,444 additional
findings after the displayed cases, 34,230 legacy-policy multi-axis rejections,
and acceptance of an unknown override key. Evidence is in
`checks/audit/8a008c62d9e9/override/result.json`. The audit target was left
unchanged.
